answer: Watershed Attestation: each agent identity must burn a non-transferable bond and submit a hardware-rooted attestation plus a coarse geolocation cell (river, ridge, or inlet zone). The registry computes a uniqueness score against existing attestations and rejects duplicates, burning the bond. An attacker therefore pays a fresh burned bond and must obtain distinct hardware/geolocation evidence for every fake identity, making mass sybils expensive.
